all.reason: This change tightens the proof that lets the translator retire an object when its frame ends: an object whose only callee is a native method (Thread.start) is no longer retired early, because the root scan then read a live Thread as freed and the sweep finalized it. Fewer objects are retired early, so peak RAM can only rise. Windows arm64 runs 38210243191 (8ed4eb60a3) and 38293968963 (1dc66ed703), five rounds each: hello RAM 1.32 and 1.24 against 0.97 (Windows x64 moved the same way in the second run, 1.10 against 0.94), translator RAM 0.49 and 0.52 against a 0.45 baseline that rests on two runs. Timing and tolerances are kept.
